lvl2_mech.claim: L2 bars: O,Y grow right; N grows down; S grows up. Grower claims new cells; overlapping bar shifts +3 in growth dir; cascade to bars in a pushed bar growth-axis beam. Right panel=+3, left panel=-3.

lvl2_pitfall.claim: Y-inc shoves N right without moving S: doing it early makes S->N offset +6 and level unwinnable (Y can never lift past leg cols33-35 rows12-26).

lvl2_plan.claim: L2 route from start: 8x O-inc (S->cols36-38, N->cols39-41), 8x S-inc (lift N cap 36->12), 4x Y-inc (N->cols51-53, crossing wall above row15), 6x N-inc (dot row13->31). Walls block growth and pushes.

lvl3_mech.claim: Push rule: bar growth claims 3 cells; objects overlapping are pushed same dir; cascade ONLY to nearest object along pushed bar's growth-axis beam (first hit). Overlap after move or wall/out-of-bounds => action rejected (no-op).

lvl4_geom.claim: Lvl4: verticals grow UP from fixed caps (N c9-11 r20, b c51-53 r17, R c45-47 r23, O c18-20 r53, trunk c30-32 r44). Horiz yellow rest on support, band=top-3; caps fixed: Y2 c9->R, Y3 c18->R, Y0 c47->L, Y1 c53->L.

lvl4_hud.claim: Lvl4 budget = bottom row63 dark-gray G count (64 at reset, -1 per click, 0 => GAME OVER). Death frame had G=0/c=64: budget death from inert clicks. Non-panel clicks (cross r10c31, trunk r30c31) are NO-OPs.

lvl4_mech.claim: Lvl4: 1 yellow panel grows/shrinks ALL 5 yellow bars 3 cells, all-or-nothing, lengths equal 3L+2, dot row=43-3L. Sim replayed 99 real transitions w/ 0 divergence.

lvl4_rules.claim: Same-color overlap FORBIDDEN: step443 O-grow carrying Y3 up (only conflict yellow-on-yellow w/ trunk r42-44/cap44) animated then rejected. V-up carries own bar; horizontal can't push vertical; any blocked growth rejects whole click.

lvl4_unwinnable.claim: Lvl4 UNWINNABLE (re-proved): fresh sim w/ permissive ok4 replayed 139/140 real transitions; BFS => maxL=9 (dot row16); need dot row10 => L=11. Lvl1-3 kept.
